games.summary: Unbeaten Detroit (3-0) is a better team on current form than 0-3 New York, and my margin is about NY by 1.6 to DET by 2.6 against NY -3.5. Pistons +4.5 is the most likely winner; no prop passed the 2-book rule.
Rested pens and a Milwaukee bullpen game make this a no-edge number; the safest leg is Rays +1.5 (-156). No Jax strikeout prop, since only unnamed-book prices were found.

Boston is on the second night of a back-to-back laying 11.5 to a rested Brooklyn; my margin is about 10.5, so Nets +11.5 is the most likely winner (thin edge). No usage SGP qualifies and the total is only 3.4 over.
Kings are down four rotation players and 0-3, but SA -18.5 is far above my 10-point margin, so Kings +18.5 is the most likely winner (about 53%). No total edge and no priced props.
Both teams are 3-0 and the market is near a pick'em; the model projects 2.6 to 5.0 points under 235.5, so the Under is the most likely winner (about 55%). Portland +2.5 is a no-edge lean.
Near pick'em with Delaware -1.5 at a rested, home WKU team, and the 57.5 total looks about 3-4 points high. Most likely winner: WKU +1.5 (-112), a one-book DraftKings price with no proven edge.

Missouri State is a 2-5 team with the 130th-ranked scoring defense laying 4.5 to a 1-6 Sam Houston team that has the No. 3 pass defense. Most likely winner: Sam Houston +4.5 (-105), one-book price, thin edge.
